accepted_search_result.gate: lower confidence bound must be positive

governance_requirement: Explicit acceptance is required before a future PR4B0-R1 rerun.

method.estimator: arithmetic mean of one frozen-cost net observation per independent cluster
method.block_construction: one complete independent cluster is one indivisible block
method.treatment_of_costs: input observations must already apply the frozen declared cost vector
method.invalid_observation_rule: missing IDs, non-finite values, and conflicting duplicate cluster IDs fail closed; exact duplicates are deduplicated
method.deterministic_output_rule: sort by cluster ID; SplitMix64 PRNG; ascending replicate means; floor((1-confidence)*B) index
